An [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] was the '''fiancée''' of the [[Limmie/Legends|Limmie]] player [[Cael Hanarist|Cael]] of [[House Hanarist]]. The fiancée, a charming woman, was a member of one of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Noble Houses]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], causing Cael to renounce his sport and become a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Behind the scenes==
The fiancée was mentioned in Cael's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
